# PR #2840: Patch: determinize samples each side's hidden cards against that side's shown cards

Closes #2826

## What changed

The AI fills in the cards it can't see by sampling them in `determinize`. It used to sample every hidden card against one list: the cards the opponent had shown. When the AI's own library held cards it had never been shown (a dealt deck), two things went wrong:
- the AI could imagine drawing a second copy of a card it already shows, which a one-copy deck can't hold (§2.6);
- it could never imagine drawing a card that only the opponent had shown.

Now each side has its own list of shown cards and its own list of what this sampling has already given it:

- **`crates/ai/src/determinize.rs`**
  - `DetGround` keeps a shown list per side (`seen`, by owner) and records, for each card of the seat's library, which side it is sampled for (`own_library_sides`).
  - Steps 3 and 4 (face-down cards, the opponent's hand and library) use the opponent's lists, so they produce the same worlds as before.
  - Step 5 samples a card in the seat's library that came from the opponent's deck (R73, a library Pocket Chaos swapped) as the opponent's. Every other hidden card there counts as the seat's own.
  - Each sample still makes exactly one random draw, in the same order as before.
- **`crates/ai/src/observe.rs`**: the "which deck was this card created for" check moves out of `hidden_instance_ids` into a new `minted_for_deck_of`, which both files now use. Behaviour is unchanged.
- **New ruling R2826000**: the note `spec/rulings/R2826000.md`, its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/2826.md`, and edits to the §9.9 Information bullet and `crates/ai/README.md`.
- **New tests** in `crates/ai/tests/ai/determinize_sides.rs`:
  1. a dealt AI library never samples a card the AI already shows, and its cards are all different;
  2. that library can sample a card only the opponent shows;
  3. a card swapped in from the opponent's deck never samples a card the opponent shows, and shares one no-repeat list with the opponent's hand.

Worlds only change when the seat's own library holds hidden cards that did not come from the opponent's deck: a dealt AI seat (the server's All Random ladder bots), a card Transmogulate put there, or a library swapped back. Practice and the gates never deal the AI's deck.

## How I tested it

- **Before the fix**, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai determinize_sides`:
  - test 1 failed: `seed 1: c10 sampled core-064, which p1 shows`;
  - test 2 failed: `the AI's own library never took a card only p2 shows`;
  - test 3 passed, as planned (it guards the R73 case, which the fix must keep).
- **After the fix**, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --features jackioh-engine/testkit`: all passed with no existing test edited, the shown-cost, aura, trap and B11 suites included.
  - lib: 26 passed
  - `ai`: 745 passed
  - `ai_slow`: 97 passed, 7 daily-ignored
- **`cargo jackioh gate`** (smoke size), all above their floors:
  - ai-vs-random: 20 of 20 wins, 17 needed
  - ai-vs-greedy: 19 of 20, 10 needed
  - hard-vs-easy: 20 of 20, 16 needed
  - 0 search panics; the slowest perf decision took 115 ms
- **Other crates that call the AI**, all passed:
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-server --features jackioh-engine/testkit`: lib 178, server 1651, store 650
  - `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`: 460 unit tests, plus the acceptance (27), golden (3) and luau (4) suites; `apps/web/src/wire` unchanged
- **Checks**:
  - `cargo fmt --check`: ok
  - `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`: ok
  - `cargo jackioh spec check`: `1626 rulings, 3849 proofs, 47630 citations in 3104 files, 20648 links: ok`
- **`cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main`**: printed `classify: Ai`, with the AI part not checked. I ran it against a temporary commit object made with a scratch index; no branch or index moved. I did not run `--claims`: it refused without `--parent-bin`, which needs a release build of the base that I didn't make. CI's `rust (classify)` builds one. A change that touches only the AI needs no patch fragment (#2811 added none).

## Decisions the issue left open

These are recorded in R2826000; a person can reverse any of them.

- **A card from the opponent's deck in the seat's library stays on the opponent's side.** I rejected the issue's literal proposal (the whole seat library against the seat's list): it would let a swapped-in card repeat one the opponent shows.
- **The already-sampled list is split per side**, not only the shown list. The issue's reasoning, that one side's deck says nothing about the other's, applies to both.
- **Face-down and resolving cards are sampled as the opponent's on both sides.** The seat can only fail to read one while the opponent controls it.
- **Sides are decided by who owns the card now, as before**, not by the deck the card was created for. Going by origin would change worlds in every game with a steal or a board swap; it could be a follow-up.

## Departure from the plan

I also changed one comment line in `crates/ai/src/decide.rs` (about line 370): "what the opponent has shown" became "what each side has shown", because this change made it wrong. The code there is untouched.

## Worth a second look

`own_library_sides` is looked up by position in the seat's library. That holds because steps 1–4 never reorder that library and every caller passes `determinize_on` the same state it passed `det_ground`.
